skill.summary: Identifies your core career values, helps evaluate tradeoffs, and creates decision principles based on your work energy, options, and constraints.

latestVersion.changelog:
Career Values Clarifier initial release.

- Helps users clarify core career values, tradeoffs, and decision principles.
- Guides reflection on high- and low-energy work experiences.
- Maps personal values to real-world constraints and career options.
- Provides structured outputs: values shortlist, tradeoff map, flag indicators, and decision principles.
- Clearly defines safety boundaries to avoid life decisions, guarantees, or clinical advice.
